findings.title: Spider crawler reused as a page-source inspection view
findings.detail: New artifact (2026-10-17) titled Spider-Max Crawl: a view-source inspector where the spider crawls the pasted markup and grades each finding into lanes (inspect, fetch, structure, SEO/meta, a11y/perf, report). Its rule engine runs over the parsed DOM: title length, H1 count, image alt and dimensions, CLS, mixed content, target=_blank without rel, inline event handlers, placeholder hrefs, JSON-LD presence, bare phone numbers. Built as a store-side digital inspection tool; store details kept out of this digest.
